payload.criterion: The README has a Quick start section that shows the TPM plugin line and a run-shell line, and names no dashboard/tmux.conf or SE_WORKFLOW_DASHBOARD.
payload.verify_command: grep -q '^## Quick start' README.md && grep -q "@plugin 'andrewy1n/se-workflow'" README.md && grep -q 'run-shell' README.md && ! grep -nE 'dashboard/tmux\.conf|SE_WORKFLOW_DASHBOARD|source-file' README.md
